title: Book 2: Live in Chicago & Mile Marker 98 (1990)
description: From the sold-out October 12, 1990 triumph at The Midwest Horizon Arena (Midwest Horizon) to the blinding snow of December 10, 1990 at Mile Marker 98 on Interstate 81 in Newbern, Virginia—where Ryan O'Connell survives a complete T10 spinal cord injury and the family builds Protocol T-10.
